prompt:
Goal: Create a polished 3D animated character design sheet for a cheerful young girl, suitable for animation reference.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 composition on a clean white studio background with soft even lighting, no visible floor line, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Layout: Show exactly 4 character depictions across the canvas: 1 large close-up portrait on the left occupying about 40% of the width, cropped from chest upward and facing slightly toward the viewer; 3 smaller full-body turnarounds on the right arranged left to right with even spacing: front view, three-quarter side view facing right, and back view.

Character details: The character is a cheerful preteen girl with a bright playful personality. She has warm brown hair in a high messy ponytail with loose flyaway strands and side-swept bangs, large expressive brown eyes, soft rounded facial features, rosy cheeks, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, small purple hoop earrings, and an open happy smile in the close-up and front view. Add a colorful geometric triangular hair clip and a rainbow-striped ponytail tie.

Outfit: Dress her in an oversized color-block hoodie with a yellow hood and upper chest, cyan left sleeve and lower diagonal panel, purple right sleeve and diagonal panel, and a pink kangaroo pocket with pink drawstrings and dark cord tips. Pair it with navy athletic shorts with a vertical purple stripe, white crew socks with pastel colored stripes, and chunky colorful sneakers in pink, teal, yellow, purple, and white. Include a small purple wristband or watch on one wrist.

Visible counted elements: Exactly 4 character depictions total: large close-up portrait, full-body front view, full-body right-facing three-quarter view, full-body back view. Exactly 1 prominent triangular hair clip on each visible head where the front or side is visible. Exactly 1 ponytail tie. Exactly 2 hoodie drawstrings with dark tips. Exactly 2 earrings visible in the close-up if both ears are shown, otherwise at least 1 visible purple hoop earring. Exactly 2 socks and 2 sneakers on each full-body view.

Visual style: High-quality stylized 3D animation look, similar to a modern family-friendly animated film; soft subsurface skin shading, glossy lively eyes, detailed hair clumps, clean shapes, saturated candy colors, crisp character-sheet presentation, gentle shadows, professional model-turnaround lighting.

Constraints: Keep proportions consistent between all 4 depictions, preserve the same outfit colors and hairstyle in every view, use a white background only, do not add labels, props, scenery, extra characters, or text.

promptZh:
目标：创作一张精致的 3D 动画女孩角色设计图，适合作为动画参考。

画布：16:9 宽屏构图，背景为干净的白色摄影棚背景，光线柔和均匀，无可见地面线，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

布局：画布上总共展示 4 个角色形象：左侧为 1 个大型特写肖像，占据约 40% 的宽度，从胸部以上截取，略微面向观众；右侧为 3 个较小的全身三视图，从左至右均匀排列：正面视图、右侧四分之三侧视图和背面视图。

角色细节：该角色为 一位性格开朗活泼的青春期前女孩。她拥有 温暖的棕色头发，扎成高高的凌乱马尾，带有零散的发丝和斜刘海，大而富有表现力的棕色眼睛，圆润柔和的五官，红润的脸颊，鼻梁和脸颊上有淡淡的雀斑，佩戴小巧的紫色圆环耳环，特写和正面视图中露出开心的笑容。添加一个色彩鲜艳的几何三角形发夹和一条彩虹条纹马尾发圈。

服装：为她穿上 一件超大号拼色连帽衫，配有黄色兜帽和上胸部、青色左袖和下对角拼接、紫色右袖和对角拼接，以及带有粉色抽绳和深色绳头的粉色袋鼠口袋。搭配海军蓝运动短裤（带有垂直紫色条纹）、带有柔和彩色条纹的白色中筒袜，以及粉色、青色、黄色、紫色和白色相间的厚底运动鞋。手腕上佩戴一个小巧的紫色腕带或手表。

可见元素计数：总计 4 个角色形象：大型特写肖像、全身正面视图、全身右侧四分之三视图、全身背面视图。在每个可见头部的正面或侧面，均有 1 个显眼的三角形发夹。1 个马尾发圈。2 根带有深色绳头的连帽衫抽绳。特写中若双耳可见，则显示 2 只耳环，否则至少显示 1 只紫色圆环耳环。每个全身视图均有 2 只袜子和 2 只运动鞋。

视觉风格：高质量的 3D 动画风格，类似于现代合家欢动画电影；柔和的次表面皮肤渲染，明亮生动的眼睛，细致的发束，简洁的形状，饱和的糖果色，清晰的角色设计图呈现，柔和的阴影，专业的模型展示灯光。

约束条件：保持 4 个形象之间的比例一致，确保每个视图中的服装颜色和发型相同，仅使用白色背景，不要添加标签、道具、场景、额外角色或文字。
